_doc: Themed floor tiles (see docs/art/classes/terrain.md). Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead. Outputs: a 16x16 crop of an accepted 32x32 generate-image-v2 take (drawn at the pack pixel size) plus recorded edits that unify the theme tones across variants and fix seams.

recipes.subject: Subject: dark slate dungeon floor: worn irregular flagstones of dark blue-grey stone separated by thin darker cracks and packed earth.
Subject: dark graveyard soil at night: damp dark earth with patches of short dark green moss and a few sparse tufts of dark grass.
Subject: dark sandy floor inside an Egyptian tomb at night: fine dim brown-ochre sand with faint ripples and a few small sandstone pebbles.
Subject: dark prehistoric cave floor: uneven dark purple-brown rock with small pebbles and shallow cracks.
Subject: dark slate dungeon floor: many small worn irregular flagstones of dark blue-grey stone separated by thin darker cracks, packed earth in the gaps.
Subject: dark graveyard ground at night: damp dark soil with scattered patches of short dark green moss and many small sparse tufts of dark grass.
Subject: dark desert sand floor of an Egyptian tomb at night: dim brown-ochre sand with faint wavy ripples and scattered tiny sandstone pebbles.
Subject: dark prehistoric cave floor: uneven dark purple-brown rock surface with scattered small pebbles and shallow cracks.
